status: development; no quality or model-capacity claim
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory
initial_pruning: Once, before evaluating the final prompt token. No pruning of generated tokens.

quality.development: Reuse previously evaluated examples; never relabel them held-out.
quality.validation: Freeze code and threshold, then select at least 48 new paired LongBench examples, excluding prior manifests; report paired uncertainty and individual regressions.
quality.limitations: Small-screen passing is not proof of non-inferiority or safety for arbitrary workloads. No tuning on validation results. Synthetic performance prompts do not establish task quality.

capacity_claim: Require a real reproducible workload that the strongest unmodified baseline cannot run acceptably on this machine; do not impose an artificial RAM limit or infer a model tier from KV savings.
online_prefill_pruning: A separate variant from the published dense-prefill KVzap evaluation; requires its own quality validation before any claim.
